reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and is short on spare cash, A answers my worries directly: all-or-nothing with full refunds, $11,000 already pledged in writing so only $49,000 is left (close to what we gave last time), a Thanksgiving reopening and public spending reports. B is warmer but asks for $60,000 without saying what happens to my money if it falls short, and it has unfilled name placeholders.
